package.name: lidar_slam
package.description:
3D LiDAR ground segmentation for Nav2. Splits the cloud into ground and obstacles, then keeps only obstacles inside a height band measured against the locally observed ground -- filtering against local ground rather than a fixed world height is what makes this hold up on slopes.
Robot- and simulator-agnostic: it consumes a PointCloud2 and a TF frame, so the same chain runs on Gazebo, MuJoCo and hardware.
